Package com.irurueta.units

Class PowerConverter

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.units.PowerConverter
public final class PowerConverter extends Object
Does power conversions to different units. To prevent loss of accuracy, conversion should only be done as a final step before displaying power measurements.
